title: Lunna home: one home, one Painel, three tabs

screens.title: 1 · Lunna, the home
screens.why: Opens on what to do now: Lunna's offer, the block running, the one after.

pins.label: Lunna's offer first
pins.text: The existing SuggestionCard moves here from Tempo: one offer, made from the day and the deliveries. It goes once taken or turned down.

pins.label: One accent
pins.text: Encaixar applies the plan, as today. It is the screen's one filled red button.

pins.label: CTA to the calendar
pins.text: Each heading ends in a pill naming where it leads in Painel. Ver o dia opens Painel > Tarefas on the calendar.

pins.label: Agora, with its buttons
pins.text: The same EventTile as Tempo's Agora: pause, -10/+10, done. Nothing new to learn. On a break it says 'Nada em andamento'.

pins.label: Em seguida
pins.text: The next card on the calendar, task or fixed block, with its hours. Only one: this screen is not a list.

pins.label: Tab 1: Lunna
pins.text: Named after the brand ('Focus' on Focus), with the crescent mark (AppIcons.agent). The app opens here.

pins.label: Tab 2: Painel
pins.text: Tempo, Entregas and Objetivos merge into one tab. Phosphor squares-four (AppIcons.panel). Menu stays the third tab.

screens.title: 2 · Lunna, further down
screens.why: The main delivery and the main goal, each with a way to manage it.

pins.label: Main delivery
pins.text: Entregas' first: the most urgent under way, else the first not begun. The real ArtifactRow with its pace bar. A tap opens the delivery on Pendentes.

pins.label: Main goal
pins.text: The goal being measured now, Objetivos' GoalCard. A tap opens its sheet to edit it.

screens.title: 3 · Painel › Tarefas
screens.why: Ver o dia lands here: Tempo as it was, on the calendar.

pins.label: Levels as a heading
pins.text: Tarefas · Entregas · Objetivos is the screen's title, set as words (AppTitleTabs): ink for the one in front, quiet grey for the others. No pill, so it never looks like the Lista/Calendário switch below it.

pins.label: Lista / Calendário stays
pins.text: The one control on Tarefas. The choice is now kept by the shell, so the home can open the calendar directly.

pins.label: Tempo, unchanged
pins.text: Same list, same calendar, same gestures. Only the greeting and the offer left, to the Lunna tab.

screens.title: 4 · Painel › Entregas
screens.why: The deliveries, as they were, under the same heading.

pins.label: Search moves up
pins.text: Entregas' search sits at the end of the heading row, only while Entregas is in front.

pins.label: Same page
pins.text: ArtifactsPage(titled: false): the shelf filter, Em andamento, Não iniciadas, drag to begin. Nothing else changed.

pins.label: + follows the level
pins.text: On Entregas the + writes a delivery; on Objetivos a goal; on Tarefas and on Lunna something on the day.

screens.title: 5 · Painel › Objetivos
screens.why: The goals, the third level, with the same layout.

pins.label: Same page
pins.text: GoalsPage(titled: false): current, Próximos, Anteriores. Every level stays mounted, so each keeps its scroll.
